title: Grusch says Cheney was the last at the top of a legacy UFO program

tellings.quote: >> Brush said that he was the last guy to be at the pyramid when you know we had some vital legacy UFO program structure.

plain: Former Vice President Dick Cheney, according to this claim, was the last person to sit at the top of a long-running secret government program that handled UFOs, in the 2000s. Michels repeats it from David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who became a UFO whistleblower, saying Grusch told him Cheney was "the last guy to be at the pyramid" when that program still had a working structure. If true, oversight of such a program reached the highest levels of the White House.
